in_marathi.name: Dhyani
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dhyani हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dhyani is a Sanskrit word derived from the root 'dhyai', which means 'to ponder' or 'to meditate'. In Hindu mythology, Dhyani represents the contemplative state of mind and is associated with the deity Dhyani Buddha. It is a feminine name.
